svg.aria-label: A conveyor belt moves a sheet of paper past three robots and a mailbox. The sheet picks up green slop blobs, a purple inspector robot spots them with a lens and a light beam, a red editor robot strikes them out with a pen, and the clean sheet drops into the mailbox with a green check.
svg.title: A conveyor belt moves a sheet of paper past three robots and a mailbox. The sheet picks up green slop blobs, a purple inspector robot spots them with a lens and a light beam, a red editor robot strikes them out with a pen, and the clean sheet drops into the mailbox with a green check.
